description: Search the web across multiple engines (Chinese/English/Code). Supports multi-query fan-out ('queries'), timeRange filtering, site limits, fetchTop article content, and no API keys required.

engines.description: Search engines to use (default: auto-routes by query language; explicit engines do not cascade unless minResults is specified)

items.description: Search engine name. Valid values (normalize alias to canonical name): baidu, bing, csdn, duckduckgo, exa, brave, juejin, startpage, sogou, github, stackoverflow, hackernews, arxiv, code

fetchTop.description: Two-in-one search & fetch: automatically fetch full readable Markdown content for top N results (0~3) in a single turn

minResults.description: Auto-run additional engines when fewer usable results come back (default: 5 when engines omitted, 0 when engines explicitly specified)

queries.description: 1-4 queries run concurrently and merged (required if 'query' is omitted)

query.description: Single search query (required if 'queries' is omitted; use 'queries' for multi-intent fan-out)

searchMode.description: Execution mode: 'request' (HTTP only), 'auto' (HTTP with browser fallback), or 'playwright' (headless browser only)

site.description: Restrict search to specific site domain(s) (e.g. ['github.com', 'developer.mozilla.org'])

verbose.description: Include verbose diagnostic fields (engineMetrics, full failure hints, and redundant source hostnames); default false to save tokens

name: search
